method: Every Version 16 teaching page is rewritten in the Study Studio Prompt 2 teaching-script style, with no word limit. Each page uses bolded teaching bullets of connected spoken sentences with nested sub-bullets. Experiments are told naturally without report labels, figures are explained by their scientific meaning instead of a walkthrough of axes, panels or colors, and only the numbers that define conditions or carry key findings are kept. Wording uses simple order and avoids crowded or tongue-twisting phrases. Pages keep source terms bolded and add no outside information, metacommentary, colons or semicolons, padding of titles or logistics, or references to other pages. Matching review pages reuse the lecture notes, and review page 54 is authored separately.
